description: Retrieves details for a Sentry organization member or pending invitee, including role, teams, and status, using their member ID and the organization's ID or slug.

inputSchema.description: Request schema for retrieving an organization member's details.

member_id.description: The unique identifier (ID) of the organization member whose details are to be retrieved.
member_id.title: Member Id

organization_id_or_slug.description: The unique identifier (ID) or URL-friendly slug of the Sentry organization.
organization_id_or_slug.title: Organization Id Or Slug

inputSchema.title: RetrieveOrganizationMemberRequest

name: retrieve_organization_member

MemberFlags.description: Feature flags and status indicators for the member.

idp:provisioned.description: Whether the member was provisioned through an identity provider.
idp:provisioned.title: Idp:Provisioned

idp:role-restricted.description: Whether the member's role is restricted by the identity provider.
idp:role-restricted.title: Idp:Role Restricted

member-limit:restricted.description: Whether the member is restricted due to organization member limits.
member-limit:restricted.title: Member Limit:Restricted

partnership:restricted.description: Whether the member is restricted due to partnership constraints.
partnership:restricted.title: Partnership:Restricted

sso:invalid.description: Whether the member's SSO configuration is invalid.
sso:invalid.title: Sso:Invalid

sso:linked.description: Whether the member has linked SSO authentication.
sso:linked.title: Sso:Linked

MemberFlags.title: MemberFlags

OrgRole.description: Organization-level role with permissions and constraints.

allowed.description: Whether this role is allowed for the current member (legacy field).
allowed.title: Allowed

desc.description: Description of the role's capabilities and permissions.
desc.title: Desc

id.description: Unique identifier of the organization role.
id.title: Id

isAllowed.description: Whether this role is allowed for the current member.
isAllowed.title: Is Allowed

isGlobal.description: Whether this is a global role.
isGlobal.title: Is Global

isRetired.description: Whether this role has been deprecated.
isRetired.title: Is Retired

isTeamRolesAllowed.description: Whether team-specific roles are allowed with this organization role.
isTeamRolesAllowed.title: Is Team Roles Allowed

is_global.description: Whether this is a global role (legacy field).
is_global.title: Is Global

minimumTeamRole.description: Minimum team role required when this organization role is assigned.
minimumTeamRole.title: Minimum Team Role

scopes.description: List of permission scopes granted by this role.
scopes.title: Scopes

OrgRole.title: OrgRole
